verdict.rationale: Rive's own site says an agent can generate experiences "with the CLI", so an official, agent-oriented CLI does exist. The only evidence is that single homepage line: there is no CLI documentation, command reference, or install guidance. RML text-based workflows and the MCP connection are related but are not the CLI itself, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: dedicated CLI documentation (install, commands, auth), details of how agents drive the CLI, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Build interactive UI, motion, and game experiences in the Editor, or let an agent generate them with the CLI.
